city_center.name: Downtown Salt Lake City / Pioneer Park
city_center.landmark: Wasatch Range rising abruptly on the eastern skyline; Temple Square downtown; the Downtown Farmers Market at Pioneer Park is the summer-fall gathering anchor
city_center.notes: the Wasatch Front sits at the base of the Wasatch Range, with the Cottonwood Canyon ski resorts (Alta, Snowbird, Brighton, Solitude) less than an hour up-canyon -- 'the greatest snow on earth'. sources: skiutah.com Salt Lake summer markets; slc.gov grocers who carry local products.

cultural_notes: Salt Lake City sits on the Wasatch Front at the base of the Wasatch Range; the Cottonwood Canyon resorts (Alta, Snowbird, Brighton, Solitude) are less than an hour from downtown, anchoring a genuine 'greatest snow on earth' ski identity (source: skiutah.com Salt Lake summer markets + resort proximity)

the Wasatch Front is dense with farmers markets -- the Downtown Farmers Market at Pioneer Park plus Brighton and canyon-adjacent markets offer seasonal produce, dairy and honey (source: skiutah.com Local Living Salt Lake summer markets; nichehomes.com best summer farmers markets)
local grocers actively carry Utah products (local produce, meat, dairy, packaged goods) with in-store local labeling (source: slc.gov grocers who carry local products)

Pioneer / Latter-day Saint heritage shapes the civic calendar (Pioneer Day, July 24) and a strong family-size household culture (INFERRED civic framing from region knowledge -- verify tone before production)
